assumptions.A1: A generation lists the carried individuals first (score order of the carry list) and then the new individuals in selection order, which is also their evaluation order.
assumptions.A10: A generation that could not fill a single new slot is not recorded; the run ends with space_exhausted and generations_done is the last recorded generation.
assumptions.A11: The wild-type reference row is evaluated before any individual and is never counted in new_evaluations_used, reused_count or max_new_evaluations (reserved_units still reserves its 2 units).
assumptions.A2: A key becomes seen when it is selected, earlier slots of the generation being built included; a carried entry repeats an already seen key and adds nothing.
assumptions.A3: All slots of a generation are selected first (step 2 and step 4 are selection), then evaluated in order (step 3). Parents only come from the previous generation, so this changes no choice.
assumptions.A4: When no unseen key is left, a slot is skipped without any rng call, and so is every later slot of that generation.
assumptions.A5: 'At most 50 / 20 / 3 more times' are further attempts after the first one (51 / 21 / 4 in total).
assumptions.A6: A crossover child is built in position storage order and, when it is larger than M, reduced with rng.sample(child, M) over that same position-ordered list.
assumptions.A7: For a position only one parent uses, rng.random() is called even when the child already holds M mutations; the size is corrected afterwards by A6.
assumptions.A8: A carried individual is skipped by the consecutive-failure counter: it neither raises nor resets it.
assumptions.A9: min score comparison: null -> a number counts as decreased; null -> null and x -> y with y >= x count as not decreased. The patience counter starts at generation 2.

how: Written in M23 T1 by the independent oracle independent_sequence_ga_oracle.py (standard library only, no mw import) from .dryforge/spec.md 3. Score tables are INPUTS: the ones marked synthetic are selection-logic inputs, and s4_tiny_observed holds real qvina first-mode values observed in T1 (g). Nothing here is an affinity, a stability or a ranking.

s1_4pos_2312.how: synthetic space; candidate indices are consecutive in position order, as M20 assigns

s2_1pos_4.how: synthetic degenerate space: one position, so N = 4 whatever max_mutations is

s4_tiny_1ubq.how: the candidate positions and indices of m20-candidate-set-1ubq-tiny.json

s1_all_failed.how: every individual fails: the consecutive-failure brake stops at the fifth (repeated_failure) and the generation records those five

s1_basic.how: synthetic scores, default-shaped small GA: three generations, carry 1, crossover/edit/random slots

s1_evaluation_limit.how: reserved_evaluations = 6 < the slots of four generations: evaluation_limit mid-generation

s1_failures_mixed.how: half the keys fail and the others are scored or null_result: scored and null_result reset the consecutive-failure counter

s1_no_change.how: every score is equal: the minimum never decreases, so patience 1 ends it with no_change

s1_no_scored.how: no individual is ever scored: no carry, no tournament, every slot is a random slot

s1_one_scored.how: only one key is ever scored: the pool holds one individual, so every crossover slot degenerates into an edit slot on A without a second tournament

s1_reference_failed.how: the wild-type reference row fails: no individual is evaluated (reference_failed)

s1_reference_null.how: the reference row has no score (null_result): not a failure, the run continues

s1_reuse.how: the same settings with twelve reusable keys and a reusable reference: reused individuals cost no evaluation, so the run goes further

s1_ties.how: synthetic score table with many ties: the size then pick_index tie rules decide

s2_degenerate.how: one position: N = 4 = population_size, so generation 2 can select nothing (space_exhausted)

s3_single_mutation.how: max_mutations 1 (N = 6, close to population_size 4): add and remove are impossible, so the edit slots use change or move

s4_tiny_observed.how: the real tiny space with the OBSERVED qvina first-mode scores of T1 (g) (every key modeled and docked once; the scores are engine outputs, not a ranking)

s4_tiny_observed_reuse.how: the same observed table and GA seed with six reusable keys: the same path, fewer new evaluations

s4_tiny_synthetic.how: the real tiny space with a synthetic tie-heavy table (N = 26)
